historical_source: Binance Vision Spot BTCUSDT UTC original 1d candles
risk_lifecycle: NORMAL -> REDUCED @ completed UTC close drawdown >=8%; REDUCED -> NORMAL only Monday 00:00 UTC if previous completed UTC close DD <=4%; ANY -> HALTED @ completed close DD >=15%, liquidate at next modeled open, NEVER RESTART/RESET HIGH WATER MARK
risk_redemption_zero_target: liquidate even if absolute BTC portfolio weight difference < 0.05
trend_score: positive lookback close returns count / 3; equality/nonpositive score 0 for that lookback
base_target_btc_weight: score * min(0.50, 0.10 / annualized_sigma), invalid/zero vol => cash
stale_data_policy: fail closed; no fabricated candles and no retroactive signal generation
comment: 4% hysteresis accepted as frozen research parameter, not optimized and not proven best. Only newly arrived data after freeze counts as prospective observation. Monthly/BTC alternative source and 4h gap remain distinct.
paper_execution_caveat: Daily-archive shadow fill at modeled UTC next daily open is recorded after archive closes; this does not validate live order latency or real execution price.
